operations.description: This operation deletes an existing collection.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete collection [PATH] collections [PARAMS] collection name [SCHEMA] collection error found internal message not

operations.description: This operation deletes an existing index.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete index [PATH] databases [PARAMS] index name [SCHEMA] error found index internal message not

operations.description: This operation returns a list of your Pinecone collections.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list collections [PATH] collections [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] collection collections list name

operations.description: Get a description of a collection.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] describe collection [PATH] collections [PARAMS] collection name [SCHEMA] collection error found internal message name not state

operations.description: This operation returns a list of your Pinecone indexes.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list indexes [PATH] databases [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] index indexes list name

operations.description: Get a description of an index.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] describe index [PATH] databases [PARAMS] index name [SCHEMA] database dimensionality error found index internal message metric name not pod state status type vector

operations.description: This operation specifies the pod type and number of replicas for an index.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] configure index [PATH] databases [PARAMS] index name [SCHEMA] bad configuration error found index internal message not pod request type

operations.description: This operation creates a Pinecone collection.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create collection [PATH] collections [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] bad collection definition error index internal message name request

operations.description: This operation creates a Pinecone index. You can use it to specify the measure of similarity, the dimension of vectors to be stored in the index, the numbers of replicas to use, and more.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create index [PATH] databases [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] bad collection config definition dimensionality error index internal message metadata metric name pod request type vector

operations.description: The `DescribeIndexStats` operation returns statistics about the index's contents, including the vector count per namespace and the number of dimensions.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] describe index stats [PATH] describe index stats [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] describe dimensionality filter index namespace request response stats vector

operations.description: The `Query` operation searches a namespace, using a query vector. It retrieves the ids of the most similar items in a namespace, along with their similarity scores.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] query [PATH] query [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] data filter id match metadata name namespace query request response sparse vector

operations.description: The `Delete` operation deletes vectors, by id, from a single namespace. You can delete items by their id, from a single namespace.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete [PATH] vectors delete [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] delete filter id name namespace request response vector

operations.description: The `Fetch` operation looks up and returns vectors, by ID, from a single namespace. The returned vectors include the vector data and/or metadata.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] fetch [PATH] vectors fetch [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] data fetch id name namespace request response vector

operations.description: The `Update` operation updates vector in a namespace. If a value is included, it will overwrite the previous value. If a set_metadata is included, the values of the fields specified in it will be added or overwrite the previous value.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update [PATH] vectors update [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] data metadata name namespace request response sparse update vector

operations.description: The Upsert operation writes vectors into a namespace. If a new value is upserted for an existing vector id, it will overwrite the previous value.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] upsert [PATH] vectors upsert [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] data id metadata name namespace request response sparse upsert vector
